newsitem.title: USA: Payco acquisition by private firm closes.
newsitem.headline: Payco acquisition by private firm closes.

text.p: Outsourcing Solutions Inc said Thursday it had completed the previously announced acquisition of Payco American Corp in a transaction and refinancing valued at about $305 million.
Payco provides accounts receivable management services, including contingent fee services, portfolio purchasing and other related outsourcing services.

Outsourcing Solutions acquired Payco for $14 a share plus the assumption of debt and certain liabilities, with these three components totalling $158.6 million. Another $146.4 million was used to refinance Outsourcing Solutions's existing debt and to provide $58 million in capital for future acquisitions.

Outsourcing Solutions is owned by McCown De Leeuw & Co and Outsourcing Solutions management, with Chase Capital Partners, Clipper Group, Goldman, Sachs & Co and Heller Financial as minority co-investors. McGown De Leeuw is a private equity investment firm.
